extracted.intended_audience: Christian readers seeking guidance in contemplative/spiritual life (novices, contemplatives, devotees)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and standards for interior Christian/spiritual life: how to pray, detach, endure temptation, and order exterior actions so the soul advances toward union with God. Emphasis on humility, renunciation, patience, vigilance, and consulting God in decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate humility and recourse to God in temptation
rubrics_metrics.description: Le premier mouvement de l'âme éprouvée par la tentation doit être de s'humilier, de reconnaître son impuissance; et aussitôt de recourir avec une vive foi à celui qui seul est sa force: 'Seigneur, sauvez-moi, car je vais périr.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On must humble oneself and call on God at the first sign of temptation; God will hasten to help, extending his 'main toute-puissante' and calming the storm (cf. Jesus commanding wind and sea). Anti-pattern: attempting to cope in one's own strength or delaying the cry for help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept trials with patience and submit to God's will
rubrics_metrics.description: When afflicted one must say 'que votre volonté se fasse' and bear tribulation with patience, recognizing that suffering can be for one's salvation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Endure trials without murmuring; rejoice that suffering can be a remedy from the ‘celestial physician’ and a means to humility. Example: imitate Christ who prayed 'Non pas ce que je veux, mais ce que vous voulez.' Anti-patterns: impatience, despair, demanding immediate removal of trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pray early rather than seek outward consolations
rubrics_metrics.description: What especially removes heavenly consolations is that you recourse too late to prayer: 'avant de me prier avec instance, vous cherchez au dehors du soulagement et une multitude de consolations.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult God first instead of running to external remedies. Anti-pattern: pursuing worldly consolations or remedies before turning inward in prayer; result is little benefit and missed grace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust God alone for effective deliverance and counsel
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize 'c'est moi seul qui délivre ceux qui espèrent en moi' — outside God there is no effective help, no useful counsel, no lasting remedy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not judge by present feelings; wait on the Lord who 'viendra et je vous guérirai.' Expect restoration and greater gifts when God chooses. Anti-pattern: relying on human plans or transient comforts as ultimate help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detach from all creatures to attain contemplation
rubrics_metrics.description: Qu'il faut oublier toutes les créatures pour trouver le Créateur — one must rise above creatures, detach perfectly from oneself and the world to fly freely to God ('Qui me donnera des ailes...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perfect detachment is necessary for contemplative union; while attached to creatures one cannot occupy oneself freely with God. Observations: few contemplatives because few fully detach. Anti-pattern: clinging to created goods while professing contemplative aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mortify and purify interior affections
rubrics_metrics.description: Le grand obstacle est qu'on s'arrête à ce qu'il y a d'extérieur et de sensible, et que l'on s'occupe peu de se mortifier véritablement... Nous ne considérons point jusqu'où descendent nos affections, et nous ne gémissons point de ce que tout en nous est impur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular interior examination and mortification of affections are required because corrupt inner affections corrupt actions; the fruits of a good life grow only in a pure heart. Anti-pattern: focusing on external works while neglecting inner purification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer heavenly wisdom to worldly knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a great difference between the wisdom God gives and the science a doctor acquires by study: 'La science qui vient d'en haut... est bien supérieure à celle où l'homme parvient laborieusement.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek the 'or éprouvé par le feu' and the 'perle précieuse' of heavenly wisdom rather than honors, learning, or praise of the world. Anti-pattern: valuing secular success/learning over spiritual wisdom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renounce self entirely to obtain true freedom
rubrics_metrics.description: Quittez tout, et vous trouverez tout. Renounce your desires and even your will; perfect freedom comes from complete self-abnegation: 'Vous ne pouvez jouir d'une liberté parfaite, si vous ne vous renoncez entièrement.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Renounce continuously, without reserve, in small and great things; partial renunciations or those with reservations prevent progress. Anti-pattern: offering oneself briefly or with reserve and reclaiming gifts when tempted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the will and intention single and purified toward God
rubrics_metrics.description: Purify the intention so that, simple and right, it remains constantly directed to God and does not stop at inferior objects: 'Il faut donc purifier l'intention, afin que, simple et droite, elle se dirige constamment vers moi.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid divided love and seeking self or reputation; the wise soul fixes itself on the final end (God) rather than transient feelings or honors. Anti-pattern: acting for show, divided affections, or self-seeking motives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect continual temptation; use spiritual arms (patience, vigilance, prayer)
rubrics_metrics.description: You will never have security in this life; as long as you live, spiritual arms are necessary: 'Si vous ne vous couvrez donc de tous côtés du bouclier de la patience... veillez et priez, afin que vous n'entriez point en tentation.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare for constant struggle: patience, courage, prayer, watchfulness, and perseverance are required. The reward comes to the persevering. Anti-pattern: seeking earthly rest or assuming temptations are over.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not be troubled by men's vain judgments; seek God's verdict
rubrics_metrics.description: Ne craignez point les jugements des hommes, quand votre conscience vous rend témoignage de votre innocence... 'Qu'avez-vous à craindre d'un homme mortel?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept unjust reproach with humility and patience; trust God who knows hearts and will render each his due. Example: Paul remained indifferent to human judgments though he sought others' edification. Anti-pattern: guarding reputation with excessive zeal or reacting in anger to slander.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain interior freedom while acting in externals
rubrics_metrics.description: En tous lieux... vous devez vous efforcer de demeurer libre intérieurement, et maître de vous-même, de sorte que tout vous soit assujetti, et que vous ne le soyez à rien.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be the master of your exterior actions, using created things to serve the good according to God's order. Do not be enslaved by external circumstances; order externals to the eternal. Anti-pattern: allowing external things to dominate interior life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult God in secret prayer before external decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: If in events you do not trust appearances but first enter, like Moses, into the tabernacle to consult the Lord, you will sometimes receive his divine answer... the prayer was his unique recourse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before acting, seek God in the secret of the heart; examples: Moses consulting God in the tabernacle; error example: Joshua and the Israelites were deceived because they had not consulted the Lord. Anti-pattern: acting rashly on first impressions or human advice without prayer.
